{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''crime syndicate''' run by members of the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] employed the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] courier [[Prit Kessek]]. Kessek was employed by the syndicate to collect satchels of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at various [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]], from couriers working for a [[Unidentified Hutt-controlled company|company]] controlled by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species. The Shadowport and Hutt companies' courier would change with each delivery as would the identity that Prit assumed. The credits were payment from the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]] to the [[Thanda clan]] of [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], whom Taug had helped purchase a fleet of [[slaveship]] which he paid upkeep and maintenance for. Prit would then deliver the credits to [[Atlee Thanda]], a member of the Thanda clan, above [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], a planet to which the syndicate had links.<ref name="ZT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030724takedown|text=Zygerrian Takedown|int=Zygerrian Takedown}}</ref>
{{RPG}}
The courier operation run by the syndicate was put to an end when a group of hired [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] impersonating a courier, replaced Prit and then captured Atlee and handed him over to the authorities.<ref name="ZT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Herglic crime syndicate was first mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'' which was released online by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and designed by [[Jason Fry]]. This article assumes that the players successfully capture Atlee as this is the suggested aim of the adventure, although his [[Death/Legends|death]] is also a possible outcome. Prit's survival in the adventure is optional.
